steps.en: The officer presses the button to proceed with permanent suspension.
steps.id: Officer menekan tombol untuk melanjutkan permanent suspension.

steps.en: The form checks that a suspension code was chosen.
steps.id: Form memeriksa bahwa suspension code sudah dipilih.

steps.en: Nothing is changed yet until the officer confirms.
steps.id: Belum ada data yang berubah sampai officer mengonfirmasi.

steps.en: A summary of the notices is shown before the officer confirms.
steps.id: Ringkasan notice ditampilkan sebelum officer mengonfirmasi.
steps.why_en: The summary sits in a separate tab; the confirm pop-up itself only shows a generic question.
steps.why_id: Ringkasan ada di tab terpisah; pop-up konfirmasi hanya berisi pertanyaan umum.
